notes: «قال مسلم» is the compiler speaking and is not written as a link (rule 13)
«وممن روى ذلك عنه إبراهيم بن سعيد الجوهري» names a different transmitter from the same Abu Usama: a variant group, not a route (rule 4)
«وحدثت عن أبي أسامة» (Muslim's own line) and «حدثنا أبو أسامة» are read as the one route head «أبو أسامة»; the text does not repeat them in succession, so this is a reading the archive should check
